summary: Bind bootstrap prerequisite ownership before native allocation

delivery.outcome: Publish 0.20.99 with declared ownership for all installed governance artifacts and a closed exact-base/digest-bound prerequisite ownership plan, so real first native allocation can include the complete package and an explicitly requested unowned prerequisite without receipt edits or allocator bypass.
nonGoals: No arbitrary or already-owned path takeover
No target repository changes in the standard source
No merge, runtime or writer authority from a plan
No broad budget increase or checker bypass

architecture.decision: Declare the two missing package paths in the default governance workstream. Accept an external ownership plan only for explicit first bootstrap or scaffold migration; validate exact committed prerequisite files, existing ownership and base twice before mutation. Project exact paths into the target-owned manifest and authentic installer receipt.
architecture.rollback: Use the previous published package; do not rewrite installer receipts or relax native allocation.
